title: Anti-narcotics agents nab 2 suspects, seize P4M in meth in Lanao del Sur

blocks.text: MARAWI CITY, Lanao del Sur – A joint buy-bust operation on Friday, Nov. 20, by the Philippine National Police Regional Drug Enforcement Unit and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao ( BARMM) netted two men allegedly involved in illegal drug trade at Lilod Saduc village here.
